LLM Router · Puneet Devnani

Adaptive verification and recovery for local AI agents

A reproducible study of model choice, semantic checking, and bounded recovery. This dashboard displays saved experiments. It does not run a model or claim new latency measurements.

Measured policy comparison

PolicyRunsCorrectMean effortMean calls

Effort includes measured generation, prompt evaluation, model loading, and tool/check time. Three held-out template groups provide limited generalization evidence.
